name: output
label: Output
description: The output from the data resource(s)

name: instanceId
label: Element id
description: Element id of the data resource element that is selected

name: isInherited
label: Is inherited
description: True if the resource is inherited from an ancestor macroponent

name: isDependentController
label: Is dependent controller
description: True if the resource is a dependency of another controller

name: isPageCollectionMode
label: Is page collection mode
description: True if we are inside a page collection

name: currentExtensionPoint
label: Current extension point
description: The extension point we are currently within

name: selectedDataResource
label: Selected data resource
description: The data resource we are seeing a preview for

name: hideBindingHelper
label: Hide binding helper
description: Determines if the binding helper should be hidden or not

name: disableArrowIcon
label: Disable arrow icon in pills
description: Hides the up arrow in the json navigator pills

name: disableDragDrop
label: Disable drag and drop in pills
description: Disables drag and drop in the json navigator pills
